newsitem.title: GREECE: BANKS OK'D TO ISSUE LETTERS OF CREDIT TO BROKERS-BOG.
newsitem.headline: BANKS OK'D TO ISSUE LETTERS OF CREDIT TO BROKERS-BOG.

text.p: The Bank of Greece on Thursday allowed credit institutions to issue letters of credit to brokers for settlement purposes with the bourse's clearing house, it said.
"To facilitate the normal settlement of trades at the Athens stock exchange, the Bank of Greece allows credit institutions to issue letters of guarantee to brokerages," it said in a statement.
The statement, signed by deputy governor Panagiotis Thomopoulos said the decision will apply to the settlement of trades up to January 10 1997.
